lead_raw_text:
The cubic crystal structure of Rb12Li4Br24 (reduced formula Rb3LiBr6) adopts space group F-43m (No. 216) with 40 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Li centers in octahedral coordination by six Br neighbors, while Rb centers exhibit both octahedral and six-coordinate Br environments; Br centers have two geometric neighbors, one Li and one Rb. The connectivity forms a three-dimensional periodic network, with Li and Rb octahedra linked through corner-sharing and additional face-sharing between Li and Rb polyhedra.
